lines.en: Imani and I show up at the bar before anyone else does, but I can't confirm whether or not that's a calculated effort on their behalves this time.
lines.zh: Imani 和我先于所有人到了酒吧,但这一次我无法确认,这对他们而言是不是精心算计。

lines.en: I'm going to assume it's not as I think my friends are better than taking advantage of me at my lowest but, at the same time, I kind of hope it is because I don't deserve to be friends with nice people.
lines.zh: 我倾向于假设不是——我认为我的朋友们不至于趁我最低谷占我便宜。但与此同时,我又有点希望是,因为我不配和好人做朋友。

lines.en: The two of us waste no time at all in getting the ball rolling as we order the first round of drinks to reward ourselves for our punctuality.
lines.zh: 我们俩毫不拖延地开场——点下第一轮酒,犒劳自己的守时。

lines.en: Imani then proceeds to poke and prod at my crumbling exterior in an effort to pick me up, but I think it does more harm than good as it kind of just makes me want to strangle her.
lines.zh: 接着 Imani 开始戳弄、试探我摇摇欲坠的外壳,想把我捞起来。但我觉得弊大于利——它只会让我有点想掐死她。

lines.en: I guess it's possible that's what she wants, though. There are weirder and less acceptable fetishes after all. And at least she can't get arrested for hers.
lines.zh: 不过,我猜那也许正是她想要的。毕竟世上还有更怪、更不可接受的癖好。而且至少她的这个,不会被逮捕。

lines.en: Eventually, the rest of the group shows up and apologizes for being late.
lines.zh: 最终,其余的人到了,为迟到道歉。

lines.en: As it turns out, another sinkhole opened up on the opposite end of town and delayed their arrival as they'd been out shopping together and had to take an alternate route here.
lines.zh: 原来,镇子另一头又塌了一个天坑,耽误了他们——他们当时正一起逛街,不得不绕道过来。

lines.en: They order drinks and we raise our glasses to sinkholes. I don't really get it since they've done nothing but cause problems for them so far, but I go along with it regardless.
lines.zh: 他们点了酒,我们为天坑举杯。我不太懂——天坑到目前为止给他们添的全是乱子——但我照样奉陪。

lines.en: Because my experience with sinkholes is a little bit better.
lines.zh: 因为我的天坑经历,稍微好一点。

lines.en: And in a roundabout way, I think that's what brought all of us together.
lines.zh: 而绕着弯说,我想,那正是把我们所有人聚到一起的东西。

lines.en: So I toast to the hope that, some day, one won't tear us apart.
lines.zh: 所以我举杯,祝愿某一天,天坑不会把我们撕开。
